_doc: The living half of the AUREA-LATTICE-002 page. The card's URL is burned into a chip and can never change, so this page is the only place depth can accumulate: someone who taps the card again next month should find something that was not here today. Adding an entry is a JSON edit and a deploy — never a new page and never a new URL. Newest first. Every number here is on the page above or is arithmetic on numbers that are; nothing here was measured off a built object, because nobody has built one.

entries.en: At 97% the fit holds and the bracer shrinks
entries.body_en: Step 01 warns that a 97% print leaves every joint loose. It does not: the tab and the slot shrink together, so the fit holds and the bracer comes out 3% small.
entries._audit_body_en: Step 01 says a 97% print leaves every joint loose. Both halves are on the same sheet, so both shrink: the 12.0 mm tab becomes 11.6 mm and the 12.4 mm slot 12.03 mm. The gap only drops to 0.39 mm — what comes out 3% small is the bracer.

entries.en: Two tolerances and the gap is gone
entries.body_en: The sheet allows ±0.2 mm, and the gap that holds the joint is only 0.4 mm. A tab at the wide end and a slot at the narrow end are both 12.2 mm, and no gap is left.
entries._audit_body_en: The sheet allows ±0.2 mm, and the gap that holds the joint is only 0.4 mm. A tab at the wide end is 12.2 mm. A slot at the narrow end is 12.2 mm too, and then there is no gap left.
